t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Picking the basket colour affects task success - for example, picking pink/red and getting the red basket will give you the most. Switch to a different colour when it stops giving you lots of mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Success seems to be down to colour themes. There are two basket colours - yellow and red. When you choose a gnome with a related colour e.g. pink/purple/red you get a red shopping basket. It seems you choose these coloured gnome hats until the number reduces (sometimes to 0) and the basket 'empties'. When this happens you switch to yellow themed gnome hat choices e.g. yellow, orange, green and blue, and do the same until the basket slowly gets less successful for you empties. Then you go back to red themed colours and keep going until it's over. Good luck!
